answer: Locks are recorded in zephyr, expire in whisper, and timber lists each expiry. An attacker running 57 aliases therefore needs 181 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3200 identities would post 2651 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
